points.guidance: Official B1: independent award; the stated criterion must be explicitly satisfied.

points.text: Charge carriers moving normal to magnetic field.
Charge carriers experience a force normal to I and B.
Charge build-up sets up electric field across slice, or build-up of charges results in a p.d. across slice.
Charge stops building up/VH becomes constant when FB = FE.
VH inversely proportional to number density n of charge carriers.
Number density of charge carriers lower in semiconductors, so VH larger for semiconductor slice.
VH proportional to drift velocity v.
For same current, drift velocity higher in semiconductors, so VH larger for semiconductor slice.
